scale_source.source: all q25/q50/q75/q90 rounded candidate radii from the successful response-independent v0.75 spatial result
scale_source.duplicate_rounded_radii: collapse exact duplicate radii before averaging so an identical graph is not double-weighted

R0: all frozen v0.76 local habitat-reference axes

R2_feature_rules.nearest_other_island_km: minimum great-circle distance to any other frozen island node
R2_feature_rules.area_weighted_surrounding_landmass_press: mean_s log(1 + sum_{j != focal} area_ha(j) * exp(-d(focal,j)/s))
R2_feature_rules.mainland_stepping_stone_frequency: fraction of unique frozen-radius graphs where the focal component contains at least one island with direct mainland distance <= that radius

R3_feature_rules.training_global_occupied_fraction: number of effective training presence islands divided by effective training island count
R3_feature_rules.nearest_training_presence_km: minimum great-circle distance from focal island to an effective training presence
R3_feature_rules.multi_source_pressure: mean_s log(1 + sum_{effective training presence a} exp(-d(focal,a)/s))
R3_feature_rules.area_weighted_source_pressure: mean_s log(1 + sum_{effective training presence a} area_ha(a) * exp(-d(focal,a)/s))

C_feature_rule.occupied_component_frequency: fraction of unique frozen-radius graphs where the focal island connected component contains at least one effective training presence
C_feature_rule.interpretation: species-conditioned insular source continuity after direct/diffuse source terms are already in R3

diagnostics_not_primary_predictors.direct_occupied_neighbor_frequency: fraction of unique radius graphs with a training presence directly within radius of focal
diagnostics_not_primary_predictors.multi_hop_only_frequency: fraction of unique radius graphs where a training presence is reachable in the component but none is directly within radius
diagnostics_not_primary_predictors.purpose: decompose any future C signal descriptively without changing the frozen primary C feature

training_only_rules.zero_effective_training_presence: non-estimable; never impute or lower gate

numerics.aggregation: Python math.fsum then equal mean over unique frozen scales
